name: assets_handover_line
description: GH #3889 / REQ-753 (assets C11). One line of a hand over of assets to another org unit or location (cause handover, prefix AHO): one asset card and a quantity. header_id is the record_id of the assets_handover header; the foreign key promotes it to a uuid column with ON DELETE RESTRICT. org_unit_id is the header's value copied by the module (scope column). Written only by module assets; after issue nothing of a line changes.
